examples.japanese: ⟦{崖|がけ}→崖：05391_gake⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{真下|ました}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{流|なが}れている→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧。
examples.english: A river flows directly below the cliff.
It's scary to look directly below.
There's a cafe directly below my room.

notes:
{真下|ました} combines the prefix {真|ま} (true, exact) with ⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧ (below), emphasizing "directly" or "right" below with no deviation.

THE {真|ま}- PREFIX:
The prefix {真|ま} attaches to direction and position words to mean "directly" or "exactly":
- ⟦{真上|まうえ}→真上：07784_maue⟧: directly above
- ⟦{真横|まよこ}→真横：16717_mayoko⟧: directly beside
- {真後|まうし}ろ: directly behind
- {真前|まえ}: directly in front
- ⟦{真|ま}ん{中|なか}→真ん中：00968_mannaka⟧: the very center

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {真下|ました}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: directly below (location)
- {真下|ました}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: from directly below
- {真下|ました}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to look straight down

USAGE:
Often used with buildings, cliffs, and vertical contexts. Unlike ⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧ which can mean "below" in a general sense, {真下|ました} always implies a strict vertical relationship.
